title: Suggest Resolve Pre-flight Checklist T3 Reference
desc: T3 reference tier. KEYWORD GUARD FAIL amend pattern, RIQUA items, verified test history.
steps: KEYWORD GUARD FAIL -> AMEND: git commit --amend to add bug title keywords. Pattern: 'fix(X): desc -- key symptom words'. One commit satisfies keyword guard AND file-coupling guard. NEVER use unrelated commits as workaround.
RELATED SKILLS: suggest-workflow (resolve command), suggest-resolve-evidence-conventions (hidden-window limits, filename guard), ask-suggest-priority-batching (triage pipeline).
RIQUA [evidence filename]: script name must follow test-{cmd}-{subcmd}-description convention. Generic names rejected by filename guard.
